data.description: Investor Deal | Single Row | Close to Park and Pool
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this elegant 3-bedroom villa for sale in Eden, The Valley by Emaar, Dubai.

Nestled within one of Dubai’s most family-friendly master communities, this beautifully designed duplex villa offers a perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and contemporary living. Featuring spacious interiors, abundant natural light, and serene community surroundings, the property is ideal for both end-users and investors.

Property Features:
3 Spacious Bedrooms
Tenanted
Duplex Layout
Open-Plan Living and Dining Area
Modern Open Kitchen with Upper and Lower Cabinetry
Built-in Wardrobes
Contemporary Bathrooms with Bathtub and Shower
Floor-to-Ceiling Sliding Doors
Private Garden and Outdoor Paved Area
Balcony/Terrace Access
Large Windows Maximizing Natural Light
Pool, Garden, and Community Views
Covered Parking
Unfurnished
Community Amenities:
Community Swimming Pool
Landscaped Parks and Green Spaces
Children's Play Areas
Walking and Cycling Tracks
Outdoor Recreation Areas
Retail and Dining Options
24/7 Security
Easy Access to Major Highways
About Eden, The Valley
The Valley is a thoughtfully planned residential community by Emaar Properties, offering a tranquil suburban lifestyle surrounded by lush green landscapes and modern amenities. Designed with families in mind, Eden features beautifully crafted villas and townhouses, expansive open spaces, and a vibrant community atmosphere.

Residents enjoy convenient access to key destinations across Dubai while benefiting from a peaceful environment that promotes outdoor living and community engagement. With its parks, leisure facilities, and family-oriented amenities, Eden presents an exceptional opportunity to own a home in one of Dubai's most promising residential developments.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933

For more information or to arrange a viewing, please contact Provident Real Estate today.
